report.explanation: All admitted evidence is healthy: gateway, order, and payment logs show 200/ok, and gateway metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters. No candidate cause in the taxonomy is supported, and the alert's failing component is unidentified. Handing off for the missing evidence rather than asserting a root cause.
missing_evidence: No error, timeout, or saturation signal in any admitted observation; need failing-request evidence (5xx, timeouts, pool waiters) to bound a cause.
No per-service latency or dependency-timeout data for order and payment; need those metrics to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
No memory-retention time series for gateway; a single sample cannot establish or exclude memory-leak.
No deployment or configuration-change records; needed to test bad-configuration.
No alert-aligned service facts identifying which checkout component triggered the alert.
